text:
ellen: Heads-up  design pass on the new dashboard chart styles. Big thing: legend density + axis label collisions on compact layouts.
rio: On mobile narrow mode the Y labels overlap each other when ticks are dense. Looks noisy.
mina: Can we abbreviate units by default (K, M) and show full units on hover? But keep an option to always show full numbers for power users.
dave: Abbrev is fine but ensure tooltip shows raw number and that screen reader reads the full value.
chris: Also the legend currently sits above the chart and shifts layout. Proposal: move legend to a collapsible side rail on narrow widths; default collapsed with a small badge showing active series count.
mina: Side rail helps keep chart area stable. For small-multiples keep the rail collapsed and put a global legend toggle per row.
a11y-bot: Checklist: "axis labels must have aria-description with unit; abbreviations must have full-value aria text; legend collapse should have aria-expanded and a skip link to series list".
elllen: (typo) meant ellen: For smoothing we have two concerns: visual smoothing that hides micro spikes, and performance smoothing where we downsample. Need separate names: "visual smoothing" and "downsample".
rio: Good call. In the UI call them "Visual smoothing (applies to rendering only)" and "Downsample for performance" with short help text.
mina: Outlier handling: current behavior is to clip extreme points which changes the Y-axis scaling and misleads viewers. Suggest instead dimming + mark + tooltip explaining point clipped from scale.
dave: Marking clipped points is important. Could show a tiny caret on top of chart with hover to show original value.
chris: Copy tweak: change "clipped" language to "excluded from auto-scale" and in tooltip show original value and reason e.g., "excluded: >99.9th percentile".
a11y-bot: VoiceOver note: ensure that clipped markers are keyboard focusable and announced as "data point excluded from auto-scale, value <num>, press enter for details".
elllen: Axis ticks: let's add an option to toggle between linear tick spacing vs smart tick spacing that favors round numbers. Default to smart.
rio: For tiny charts, hide minor ticks and only show major ticks with a condensed numeric format.
mina: Legend microcopy: propose button label "Series" with accessible label "Show series details (N)" where N is series count. When collapsed, tooltip reads "Open series list".
dave: Performance note: canvas renderer can't easily animate alpha per point; prefer a GPU uniform and a small texture mask as Chris mentioned earlier. We'll coordinate with runtime.
chris: I'll prototype a small preview that shows abbreviation hover, a collapsed side rail, and outlier markers.
elllen: Action items: Mina drafts concise unit-abbrev copy + aria examples; A11y-bot to add checklist entries and example aria strings; Chris to prototype side-rail + marker; Dave to coordinate renderer constraints with eng-runtime.
mina: Will post copy options in #design later today.
a11y-bot: Added checklist item: "abbrev label aria=\"full number\" on hover/keyboard focus".
dave: I'll open an infra note re: uniform alpha and mask texture.
chris: Plan to demo in Friday sync.
elllen: Thanks everyone, trying to land these before next sprint. :thumbsup:
